counting_unit: A reported specification is counted once within one empirical family. Coefficients from the same multivariate fit are not separate specifications. Pretrend and pseudo-break fits are diagnostics. Permutation, randomisation and power-simulation fits are resampling refits and never inflate the reported-specification count.

families.note: Thirty-six primary and 108 robustness break specifications; each carries a pretrend slope and pseudo-break diagnostic, with six additional selection checks. Placebo-date refits are counted only as resampling. The family is retired because Merge placebos fire and no admissible control group remains.

families.note: Twelve V2 models remain after removing every v3 outcome that treated local virtual depth as deposited capital. Their shared artifact is provenance-stale until the exact-lag capital and reserve-reconciliation rerun, and their prior pool-only covariance is not the locked primary inference, so the family is withheld. Five joint Wald rows are derived tests, not additional fitted specifications.

Their dollar LVR numerator collapses a tick-crossing day to one volume-weighted tick, and the provider TVL denominator failed the historical-balance audit. Any future V3 family starts from an event-replayed inventory that separately passes custody and LP-ownership reconciliation plus path-integrated LVR as new specifications.

families.note: Nine v3 fits are retired because constant-product-equivalent virtual reserves measure local depth, not invested capital: role differences in risk-adjusted return and APR; unconditional and conditional risk-adjusted returns; net APR; fee yield; degree; native-quoted centrality; and the centrality-by-role interaction.

families.estimator: cross-sectional OLS and grouped-time complementary-log-log panel
families.note: The 32 reported specifications comprise 29 OLS and three grouped-time hazard models. Ten thousand permutation fits and four thousand power-simulation fits are resampling only. The result supports the architectural possibility of forced vehicle use and does not identify the later stable rotation.
